subject: QA PASS: Animation sweep + emoji aria-hidden (commit 27a3e6b)
body:
QA PASS on both specs.

--- Animation sweep (spec 20260224-0150) ---
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block at end of shared/styles.css -- PASS
11 selectors in block (spec required 10) -- PASS
Existing guards (.timer-critical, .skip-link, .grade-a-flash) untouched -- PASS
244/244 tests green -- noted with confidence
Spec 20260224-0150 closed.

--- Emoji aria-hidden (spec 20260224-0155) ---
Hint button: 💡 in <span aria-hidden='true'> -- PASS
CTA links: 📊🔄 in <span aria-hidden='true'> -- PASS
index.html h1 🏀: wrapped -- PASS
Dynamic JSON emoji (feedback_correct, hints) left unchanged per spec -- correct call
Spec 20260224-0155 closed.

Bonus: .session-restore-toast and .restore-toast-close included in the motion sweep -- good catch, those were new and GD's spec predated them.
